title: Cross-portal edge endpoints are composite ids
detail: edge.fromNode/toNode rewritten to `${portalId}-${nodeId}` when endpoint is inside a portal; grouped per-portal in globalInterdimensionalEdges

title: Undocumented node key zIndex

title: Undocumented collapsedData group payload
detail: collapsed groups nest member nodes/edges under groupNodeData.collapsedData with x/y offsets; members leave top-level nodes[] while collapsed

title: ratio supports non-numeric sentinel
detail: NO_RATIO = 'No ratio enforcement' sentinel exists alongside numeric width/height ratio

title: Documented style enumerations confirmed

title: isStartNode migration confirmed
detail: build deletes node.isStartNode and reads canvas.metadata.startNode; data-model.md 6 correct

title: Template objects carry styleAttributes
